summary: Out-of-town female hiker slipped on rocks in the rugged canyon below the Lake Isabel dam and suffered a possible broken ankle; Custer County SAR carried her ~0.3 mile over rough terrain with creek crossings (~2 hrs) to a waiting ambulance; transported to Parkview Hospital in Pueblo, expected full recovery.
location: Canyon below Lake Isabel dam, Lake Isabel area
notes: Pueblo SAR and Rye Fire assisted; Flight for Life on standby, not needed. Source: Custer County SAR mission log (courtesy Wet Mountain Tribune), published 2012-06-01; incident "last Thursday" = 2012-05-31, Thursday-verified. Site is just inside Pueblo County per source. Inserted run 1013 (PCSO chunk).
